verdict.rationale: GitCafe's docs list a first-party 'Mirror a branch with another Git server' guide. They also document a GitHub sync that brings repositories in and keeps them in sync 'one way or both', which covers to-and-from repository mirroring, but only with GitHub. The generic Git-server mirroring is evidenced only by a docs index heading, so its direction, scope and setup are unproven. Missing for 10: documented details of branch mirroring with arbitrary Git servers (push vs pull direction, scheduling or triggers, auth), whole-repository mirroring with non-GitHub servers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can mirror repositories or branches to and from another Git server

citations.quote: Mirror a branch with another Git server
